_note: Demo rules for Ontario HST (13%). Simplified for illustration. NOT tax advice: an accountant must review these before real use.

documentation._note: Simplified threshold. Verify current CRA documentation requirements.

fuel.label: Fuel
fuel.reason: Fuel: full credit assumes 100% business use. Adjust for personal use.

professional_fees.label: Professional fees
professional_fees.reason: Accounting/legal fees for the business: full HST credit.

meals.label: Meals
meals.reason: Meals and entertainment: only 50% of the HST is claimable.

entertainment.label: Entertainment
entertainment.reason: Meals and entertainment: only 50% of the HST is claimable.

club_membership.label: Club membership
club_membership.reason: Club memberships (gym, golf) are not claimable.

groceries.label: Basic groceries
groceries.reason: Basic groceries are zero-rated: no HST charged, nothing to claim.

insurance.label: Insurance
insurance.reason: Insurance premiums are exempt: no HST charged, nothing to claim.

bank_fees.label: Bank fees
bank_fees.reason: Most bank fees are exempt financial services: no HST.
